facts.text: I am trying to learn more about my family's cultural traditions.
I do Hindu prayers at my aunt's house every Sunday.
I offer modaks and flowers during the weekly prayers to Lord Ganesha.
My aunt says the weekly prayers are a family tradition passed down for generations.
My aunt is teaching me how to make modaks for the weekly prayers.
I want simple recipes for traditional Hindu sweets like jalebi and gulab jamun.
My aunt has already taught me how to make modaks.
I would love to try making jalebi and gulab jamun as well.
I have had issues with jalebi or gulab jamun being too greasy or not crispy enough in the past.
I want tips on how to deep-fry the batter or dumplings perfectly.
